code: import{useEffect}from'react';/* the 3D scene follows the pointer */export default function useParallax(sceneRef,worldRef){useEffect(()=>{const on=e=>{const sc=sceneRef.current;const w=worldRef.current;if(!sc||!w)return;const r=sc.getBoundingClientRect();const x=(e.clientX-(r.left+r.width/2))/window.innerWidth;const y=(e.clientY-(r.top+r.height/2))/window.innerHeight;w.style.setProperty('--ry',20+x*34+'deg');w.style.setProperty('--rx',-14-y*24+'deg');};document.addEventListener('pointermove',on);return()=>document.removeEventListener('pointermove',on);},[sceneRef,worldRef]);}
